Marta (AE): Heads up — Pinnacle wants a go/no-go today for their pilot. Major blockers: BYOK KMS + egress cert + POC throughput. Need an internal exec fastpath to commit resources.
Oliver (CSM): Can you summarise the asks? I have their exec on a 4:30 call.
Marta (AE): Three asks: 1) Reserved capacity for first 30 days (roughly 2x A100 equiv), 2) BYOK + key rotation support, 3) Legal signoff on data residency + SOC2 language. Also pricing ask: flat pilot cap. CTO wants exec confirmation.
Raj (Solutions): Dedicated capacity is feasible but needs infra signoff. For BYOK we'll need either Private deploy or Dedicated with VPC egress. Can we offer burst fallback?
Devon (Security): BYOK + HSM attestation ok in principle. Need crypto review and onboarding checklist. We can run expedited review if leadership approves an RFD.
Ellie (Eng): Throughput-wise we can hit their targets with quantized model + aggressive batching. Need a mirrored staging run with sample traces (under 10MB ideally). I can run perf tests today.
Marta (AE): They'll DM traces. Pricing: they want a 30-day pilot with a flat $100k cap. Can we do 30-day reserved + overage at 50% discount?
Raj (Solutions): That seems reasonable as a one-off. @Priya (RevOps) — need pricing signoff and an MOA.
Priya (RevOps): I can approve a pilot rebate if legal signs a short MOA. Need expected spend org code + pilot scope. I'll draft a one-page MOA template.
Devon (Security): Also confirm we won't retain customer data beyond pilot. Enable audit logging and provide retention SLA. I'll send the intake form.
Marta (AE): They also sent a 100-question security questionnaire. Who can help pre-fill?
Oliver (CSM): I'll take Qs 1–40, can prefill standard responses and mark org-specific items. Link to canonical QNA: https://confluence.redwood/sec-qna
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled — Exec War Room today 16:30 PT to review fastpath. Invite sent.
Raj (Solutions): Action items: Ellie to run perf test (ETA 15:00 PT), Devon to start KMS review (ETA EOD), Priya to draft MOA (ETA 17:00 PT), Legal to fast-track Qs. Marta to confirm staging window with customer.
Marta (AE): Confirmed staging window 15:00–16:00 PT. @Ellie please confirm endpoint and creds.
Ellie (Eng): I'll DM creds and spin a quick load script. Gist of load I’ll use: ```python
# simple load driver
for _ in range(1000):
    client.generate(payload)
```
Devon (Security): :thumbsup: queuing crypto & compliance team now.
Priya (RevOps): MOA draft uploaded to #sales-docs, pinged legal for signature.
Oliver (CSM): If exec signs off we can flip Dedicated tomorrow AM. Who's the final approver list?
Raj (Solutions): Approvers: Anil (CTO), Sam (VP-Infra), and Priya (RevOps) for pricing. Marta please flag them.
Marta (AE): Looping in @Anil @Sam here — please chime in if you can sign today.
Anil (CTO): I can approve expedited allocation assuming MOA limits liability to pilot scope. I'll sign if legal OKs.
Sam (VP-Infra): We have spare capacity for 30 days. Need security verification/attestation. I'll coordinate infra prep.
Marta (AE): Thanks — I'll update Pinnacle after 16:00 with current status and next steps.
Oliver (CSM): Quick summary: staging run at 15:00, perf test in progress, KMS review + MOA in motion, exec approvals pending. :rocket:
